question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.

Today, __a man who betrayed his own country__ in exchange for money was the topic of every news report.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Traitor"** means a person who betrays someone or something, such as a friend, cause, or principle. (देशद्रोही)

 
 
• **Example: **Judas Iscariot is known as a** traitor** in the Bible for betraying Jesus Christ.
 
 
 
• **"Traitor"** specifically refers to someone who betrays their own country for personal gain, often for money or power. (विश्वासघाती)
 
 
• **Example: **Benedict Arnold is infamous in American history as a **traitor** for his defection to the British during the Revolutionary War.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gangster** (अपराधी): A member of a gang of violent criminals.

 
 
• **Example:** The **gangster** was arrested after a long police chase.
 
 
 
• **Terrorist** (आतंकवादी): A person who uses unlawful violence and intimidation, especially against civilians, in the pursuit of political aims.
 
 
• **Example: **The** terrorist** was caught plotting an attack on the city.
 
 
 
• **Conman** (धोखेबाज): A person who cheats or tricks others by persuading them to believe something that is not true.
 
 
• **Example:** The **conman** convinced people to invest in his fake company.
 
 

 

54:T1083,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
